summary: Azure delegation levels follow your management-group layout, Community users see what Pro adds, and protection for delegated administration is stronger.

new.title: Azure levels follow your management groups
new.text: The Create wizard sets an Azure permission group's level from where its scope sits in your management-group tree. The preview says where the level came from.

new.title: Community shows what Pro adds
new.text: In Community, every Pro page is listed in the menu, dimmed and marked PRO, with a comparison and a way to buy or register Pro.

new.title: Update Community with one command
new.text: The Community update script now pulls the latest release and re-runs your deploy with its original settings. Without the apply option it only shows the plan.

fixes.title: Changing access review reviewers works
fixes.text: Changing who reviews an access review is now accepted by Microsoft, and PIM Manager checks the result.

fixes.title: Emergency overrides end on time
fixes.text: An emergency override now ends on time even when other work is running, and approval is put back on the next run.

fixes.title: New installations set up their mailbox
fixes.text: The one-command deploy no longer stops at the notification mailbox step. An older deploy identity gets the missing right automatically on its next deploy.

fixes.title: Stronger protection for delegated administration
fixes.text: Security hardening for delegated administrators, staged changes, break-glass accounts and managed tenant selection. MSP management is now always part of Pro.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Staged edits are no longer lost, dates keep their exact value, mail links use the Manager's own address, and the daily target check reports unreadable subscriptions correctly.
